stream_table_t

Represents an ARM SMMUv3 Stream Table Entry (STE).

This 64-byte structure acts as the root of the configuration hierarchy for an incoming hardware transaction. Based on the incoming Stream ID, the SMMU looks up this STE to determine if the transaction should bypass translation, generate an abort, or proceed with Stage 1/Stage 2 translation. If Stage 1 is configured, the S1ContextPtr field points to the corresponding context_desc_t.
